  >
  > One of the benefits of SST is capturing more conversion data that would otherwise be lost due to cookies, data flow issues, conversion lag, etc.
  >
  > There are two considerations here: conversion volume and conversion lag
  >
  > VOLUME
  > If you get 50 or fewer conversions per month, you probably don't need SST.
  > If you get more than 100 conversions per month, SST could potentially make a meaningful difference to your total conversion volume.
  >
  > LAG
  > If most of your conversions happen within 48 hours of an ad click, you probably don't need SST.
  > If at least half of your conversions come in at least 4 weeks after an ad click, SST could potentially help you capture a lot more of your conversion data,  which can drive better ad performance.

  >
  > The faster your page speed, the higher your conversion rate. And websites using SST tend to load faster than websites using client-side tracking.

  >
